features.title: Features
items: 6 first classes and 12 second classes.
Attribute points and a skill point every level; a skill tree that is one map, with 8 active skills that recharge in rounds.
105 items in 10 families, worn by slot, with set bonuses at 2, 4 and 6 pieces.
Reheat gear up to +4 at the forge, and set 19 kinds of monster card into it.
19 Landlords across 6 regions and 3 weeks.
Patrols, packs, ambushes, guardians and mimics on the map.
Day and night: at night your sight shrinks and shadows hunt you.
Your fallen hunters rise and hunt you; one of them can take a Landlord's seat as a heretic.
Separate bank and purse: stake gold at the start and cash out after each Landlord.
9 optional vows that make the road crueler and the payout bigger.
A weekly challenge with an online board, rivals from other players, and duels with friends.
Every character speaks, a narrator comments the run, and each region has its own sound by day and night.
Palettes for color blindness, shape marks, voice control on Android and a diagram for every option.
A herbarium, a bestiary and 16 feats in the Journal.
Hunters, monsters, gear and effects drawn in vector art.
Mouse, keyboard, controller and touch, in full screen on phones, tablets and PCs.
Translated into 14 languages, and dubbed in Portuguese (Brazil).

demo.title: Download the demo
demo.intro: A free demo for Windows, macOS and Linux, and on Android. It plays the whole run, with fewer choices when you build your hunter, and the rooms of the house stay closed.
includes: Your own hunter, built before the run: sex, skin, eyes, hair, outfit and name.
A starting bonus, Riposte or First Blood, and a weapon, the Iron Club or the Old Crossbow.
Classes: Swordsman and Archer, then Crusader and Knight, or Hunter and Bard.
The full run: three weeks on the map, events, shops, vows and the Landlords.
The House with its 22 rooms shut: the other bonuses, weapons, classes and item families, and the bigger purses, come with the full game.
Its own save, separate from the full game.
demo.windowsNote: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. One .exe file, no installer. The file is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn you: click More info, then Run anyway.
demo.macosNote: One app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Unzip it and drag Dawnbringer to Applications.
demo.macosOpen: The app is not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Right-click (or Control-click) the app and choose Open. If there is no Open button, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
demo.linuxNote: x86_64. Extract the archive and run DawnbringerDemo.x86_64. Needs graphics drivers with OpenGL 3.3.
demo.android: Android: the full game and the free demo are in a closed test on Google Play.
demo.ios: iPhone and iPad: not available yet.

beta.title: Join the Android alpha
beta.testCardCaption: Annotated Android test payment screenshot. The X crosses out the simulated amount. Green outlines mark the test card and Google's notice: this is a test order, you will not be charged.
beta.paymentNoticeTitle: The test is free for testers: in step 4 the payment method must say "Test card, always approves" and nothing is charged.
beta.paymentNoticeText: With the test card, Google Play only simulates a purchase: even if R$9.99 or another amount appears, no money is taken. If your own card or another real payment method appears instead, do NOT confirm. Write to us and we will enable your account:
beta.intro: Play the Android version before launch, free for testers. Four steps, about two minutes.
beta.step1: Open the group and click "Join group". A window opens: click "Join group" again at its bottom. The page then says "Successfully joined the group". Opening the group is not enough: you must join.
beta.step2: With the same account, open the test page and click "Become a tester". Wait until the page says "You are a tester."
beta.step3: On your Android phone or tablet, open the game on Google Play. The page is called "Dawnbringer (Early Access)". Tap the blue button with the price. If Google Play says the page was not found, step 2 is not finished yet: go back to step 2, check the Google account and wait a few minutes.
beta.note: Free alpha access ends at launch. Joining the test does not include a purchase of the final game.
beta.accountHelp: Use the same account in every step: the group, the test page and the Play Store. If you have several Google accounts, check the profile picture on each page and in the store app.
beta.paymentTitle: What is Test card, always approves?
beta.paymentHelp: It is Google Play's test payment card. If the payment method says Test card, always approves, confirming makes a simulated purchase with no real charge. If you see your own card or another real payment method, do not confirm. Check the account used in all three steps; if the problem continues, write to us and we will enable your account:
beta.unavailableTitle: Can't find the game or join the test?
beta.unavailableHelp: Check that you joined the group and opted into the test with your Play Store account. Wait a few minutes and reopen the test page. If you still cannot get access, send a screenshot of the message, without payment details, to
beta.buttonsNote: Use the same Google account in every step: the one signed in to the Play Store on your Android phone. The pictures show Google's screens in English; in your language the button sits in the same place. Press the one outlined in green.
beta.shotGroup: The group page. Click "Join group", outlined in green.
beta.shotJoin: The window that opens. Click "Join group" at the bottom; the name field can stay as it is.
beta.shotOptin: The test page. Click "Become a tester".
beta.shotTester: Done: the page says "You are a tester."
beta.step3Title: Open the game on your phone
beta.shotStore: Google Play on the phone. Tap the blue price button.
beta.step4: Google Play opens the payment screen. Check that the payment method says "Test card, always approves" and that the screen says it is a test order, then tap "1-tap buy". The game installs and nothing is charged.
beta.demoText: The demo is a separate app, Dawnbringer Demo, and it has no payment step. After step 1, open the demo's test page with the same account, click "Become a tester", then install it from Google Play.

press.description: Dawnbringer is a dark-fantasy roguelike auto-battler. The sun broke and the world froze, the shards that fell became money, and every week a Landlord comes to collect. Players cross a turn-based map, pick fights, and build a hunter: made before each run, then grown with a class in two steps, a skill tree with active skills, attribute points, and 105 items in 10 families worn by slot, reheated at the forge and set with monster cards. Combat resolves automatically without dice, and the game never shows how a fight will end: every foe carries visible items, so players judge each fight by reading its gear against their build, and a Stone of Despair only darkens when a fight would kill the hero. Against the Landlord it stays silent, and the player must pay the tithe or fight. Before each run players stake gold from their bank, and after each week they cash out the purse or risk it in a harder week. Between runs players spend the bank on the rooms of a house; each room brings someone who teaches a bonus or a class, makes a weapon, opens an item family or gives a bigger purse. Fallen hunters rise and hunt the player in later runs, and one of them can take a Landlord's seat as a heretic. Each week a challenge run is the same for every player, and an online board ranks it by city, region or country; players who join can meet another player's hunter as a rival in a lair, and two heroes can duel by code or on one device. Hunters, monsters, gear and effects are drawn in vector art. Every character speaks with a synthetic voice, a narrator comments the run, and the game is dubbed in Portuguese (Brazil). Options include palettes for color blindness, shape marks and voice control on Android.

return.title: Your runs come back
return.text: Fallen hunters rise and hunt you in later runs, and one of them can take a Landlord's seat as a heretic. Join the online board and another player's hunter can wait in a lair as your rival.
return.alt: A risen hunter, marked in red, walks toward the player on the map.

whatsnew.title: New in 0.8
items: Hunters, monsters, Landlords, gear and effects are drawn in vector art, sharp on any screen.

A weekly challenge: the same run for every hunter. Join the online board to rank it against players in your city, region or country (you choose what place to share), and another player's hunter can wait in a lair as your rival.
Duels: send a hero's code to a friend, or pick two saved heroes and fight on one device.
Your hunter speaks in a voice of the sex you pick, a narrator comments the run, and in Portuguese (Brazil) the characters speak Portuguese.
Accessibility: palettes for protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia, shape marks on color cues, voice control on Android, and a diagram that explains each option.
A free demo for Android, in its own app.
